purpose: independent tight-tolerance confirmation designed after the broad-kernel pilot
interpretation: confirmatory relative to the completed broad-kernel pilot; not a project-wide preregistration
selection_rule_u: minimum validation-timed cost among candidates whose Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound is at least 1-delta
selection_rule_o_star: minimum calibration-timed cost among all candidates whose calibration mean absolute error is at most the fixed threshold
seed_rule: seed_group*1000000 + split_offset + trial_index, with offsets 0, 100000, and 200000
